findings.quote: NEITHER PARTY NOR ANY OF ITS AFFILIATES SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOSS OF PROFITS OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION
findings.rationale: Section 11.5 gives a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages with sensible carve-outs, but there is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement, so our direct liability (including for the very large milestone/royalty economics) is unlimited. Our position is a mutual cap with uncapped Excluded Claims; the fallback (mutual 12-month fee cap) is also unmet.

replacement.oldText: EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
replacement.newText: EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES. EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID BY ABBVIE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION DOLLARS ($1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 5.8, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 11, AND ITS FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE; AND AMOUNTS PAYABLE UNDER ARTICLE 6 SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES FOR PURPOSES OF THIS CAP.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual aggregate liability cap; our position is that liability is capped for both parties with confidentiality, exclusivity, indemnification, fraud and wilful misconduct sitting outside the cap. Payment obligations under Article 6 are expressly not "damages" for cap purposes.

findings.quote: Harpoon shall indemnify AbbVie, its Affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, and agents (the "AbbVie Indemnitees"), and defend and save each of them harmless, from and against any and all Losses in connection with any and all Third Party Claims incurred by or rendered against the AbbVie Indemnitees arising from or occurring as a result of: [***]
findings.rationale: A Harpoon (vendor) indemnity in our favour exists with a standard notice/control/settlement procedure in 11.3–11.4, but the triggers are redacted, so we cannot confirm coverage of third-party IP infringement, breach of law and Harpoon's gross negligence/wilful misconduct. Please provide the unredacted 11.2 triggers for confirmation.

findings.quote: Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to (a) directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory
findings.rationale: The only competitive restriction runs against the vendor (Harpoon); no field-of-use or non-compete restriction binds us. This benefits us and needs no change.

findings.quote: an exclusive (including with regard to Harpoon and its Affiliates, except as provided in Section 5.6) license (or sublicense), with the right to grant sublicenses in accordance with Section 5.3
findings.rationale: Exclusivity runs in our favour (exclusive licence plus Harpoon's exclusivity covenant); we are under no sole-supplier or requirements obligation. Compliant with the preferred position.

findings.quote: Each Party hereby agrees that the terms of this Agreement fully define all consideration, compensation and benefits, monetary or otherwise, to be paid, granted or delivered by one Party to the other Party
findings.rationale: No most-favoured-nation or price-matching obligation is imposed on us anywhere in the Agreement.

findings.quote: All persons employed by a Party shall be employees of such Party and not of the other Party
findings.rationale: There is no non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binding us, which matches our preferred position.

findings.quote: AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
findings.rationale: We hold a unilateral convenience-termination right on 90 days' notice with no early-termination fee, and Harpoon has no convenience right. This sits at the fallback (60–90 days) rather than our preferred 30 days, so we accept it as drafted.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated in accordance herewith, shall continue in force and effect until (a) the date of expiration of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product
findings.rationale: The term is tied to the Royalty Term with no automatic renewal, notice window or price-uplift mechanic, so there is nothing to redline under this rule.

findings.quote: Any arbitration proceeding under this Agreement shall take place pursuant to the procedures set forth in Schedule 13.7.3.
findings.rationale: Delaware governing law sits at our accepted fallback, but disputes are subject to mandatory arbitration under a redacted Schedule 13.7.3. We need the seat and rules confirmed; a seat outside the accepted jurisdictions would be a deviation (foreign-seated mandatory arbitration is walk-away territory).

findings.quote: provided that either Party may make such an assignment without the other Party's consent to its Affiliate or to a successor, whether in a merger, sale of stock, sale of assets or any other transaction, of the business to which this Agreement relates
findings.rationale: Mutual affiliate/successor carve-out with a reasonableness standard for other assignments meets the fallback, and the change-of-control mechanics in 13.2/5.8.2 give rights to us rather than to the vendor. No vendor termination or re-pricing right on our change of control.

findings.quote: All Regulatory Documentation (including all Regulatory Approvals and Product Labeling) specifically relating to the Licensed Compounds or Licensed Products with respect to the Territory shall be owned by, and shall be the sole property and held in the name of, AbbVie
findings.rationale: Each party retains its own IP, we own the Regulatory Documentation, and jointly created IP is co-owned with an express right for each party to exploit without consent or accounting — so the joint-ownership walk-away concern does not arise. Note only that Section 12.7.1 grants Harpoon a royalty-bearing licence to certain AbbVie reversion IP on termination, which is acceptable in this reversion construct.

findings.quote: AbbVie shall have the right to grant sublicenses (or further rights of reference), through multiple tiers of Sublicensees, under the licenses and rights of reference granted in Sections 5.1.1, 5.1.2 and 5.1.3, to its Affiliates and other Persons
findings.rationale: The grant is exclusive, extends to affiliates, sublicensees and designated third-party manufacturers, is not revocable at will, and becomes fully paid-up and irrevocable on expiry of the Term (12.1.2). This meets the preferred position.

findings.quote: Such examinations may not (a) be conducted for any [***] [***] (b) be conducted more than once in any [***] period ... Except as provided below, the cost of this audit shall be borne by Harpoon, unless the audit reveals a variance [***] from the reported amounts
findings.rationale: The royalty audit is limited in frequency, run by an independent accounting firm reasonably acceptable to us with results-only disclosure, and is at Harpoon's cost absent a variance — consistent with our position. The frequency/notice figures and variance threshold are redacted; we will confirm they are once per 12 months on at least 15 days' notice.

findings.quote: AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
findings.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties or termination fees are payable by us; the non-refundable upfront and milestone payments are consideration for rights already granted and convenience termination carries no exit charge.

findings.quote: Each Party shall perform or cause to be performed, any and all of its Development activities, including Initial Development Activities, in good scientific manner and in compliance with all Applicable Law.
findings.rationale: Harpoon gives extensive IP, regulatory and compliance warranties in Section 10.2 plus performance covenants in 3.8.4 and 10.3, and the Section 10.5 disclaimer expressly preserves the express warranties, so this is not an "AS IS" deal. We note there is no fixed conformance period/repair-replace-refund remedy, which is inherent in a development collaboration rather than a deliverables contract.

findings.quote: General Liability Insurance with a minimum limit of [***] and [***] in the aggregate. General Liability Insurance shall include Clinical Trial Insurance.
findings.rationale: Section 11.6 requires workers' compensation, employer's liability and general liability (including clinical trial) cover from a rated insurer, with certificates on request and us named as additional insured. Limits are redacted; we will confirm they are at or above our thresholds.

findings.quote: Harpoon hereby grants to AbbVie the exclusive right, but not the obligation, to obtain the licenses set forth in Section 5.1.3 (the "License Option")
findings.rationale: There is no minimum purchase, take-or-pay or volume commitment on us; the licence is structured as an option we may decline, and cost-sharing is limited to defined development activities.

findings.quote: Harpoon shall, and shall cause its Affiliates to, without additional compensation, disclose and make available to AbbVie ... Regulatory Documentation, Harpoon Know-How, Joint Know-How, and any other Information claimed or covered by any Harpoon Patent or Joint Patent
findings.rationale: Exit and transfer mechanics exist: full know-how/regulatory transfer and personnel assistance on option exercise (3.5), a manufacturing technology transfer right on request (4.5.2), safety database transfer (8.2) and return/destruction of Confidential Information on termination (9.7). Note that if we terminate for Harpoon's breach under 12.6.2 no continuing assistance obligation is specified; we can live with this given the reversion construct.
